# `aitbc agent discover agents`

Search remote agents by capability, type, and minimum health score.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent discover agents [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--capability` | text | — | no | Filter by capability |
| `--agent-type` | text | — | no | Filter by agent type |
| `--min-health` | float | `0.0` | no | Minimum health score |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Maximum results |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent discover agents
```
